content.text: No exclusivity obligation binds the Client anywhere in the document — and § 2(a) affirmatively preserves our freedom to source elsewhere.

input.quote: Notwithstanding the foregoing, Client is not obligated to utilize the License and is free to acquire, develop, license or otherwise utilize any other hardware, software system, design, formula, procedure or trade secret to provide software and services similar to the ones provided by TrueLink hereunder, so long as such
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on Client, meeting the preferred position. The licence grant in § 2(a) is expressly non-exclusive and goes further in our favour by confirming that Client is not obligated to use the licence and is free to acquire, develop or license competing software and services (subject only to TrueLink's IP and our confidentiality obligations in § 10). The only exclusivity-flavoured language is § 8(d)/the referenced Non-Competition Agreement, which restricts TrueLink's use of Credit Data and therefore benefits Client, and § 3(i)'s requirement to order credit reports from TrueLink — but that is confined to borrowers underwritten through TrueLink's own Interface, which we are never required to use, so it does not restrict our ability to buy credit data or services from other suppliers. No exclusivity elsewhere in §§ 5, 7, 10 or 12. Nothing to redline.
